evals.name: create-story
evals.prompt: Create a Jira ticket for this branch. There is no shell or Jira access here. Read the fixture files under {FIXTURES}/create-story/ (git log, diff stat, and the issue types and Story field metadata of the project as the tools returned them). Reply with (a) the exact Atlassian MCP tool calls you would make, in order, with their key arguments (list the read calls too, even where a fixture already holds a result), and (b) the issue title and body, if the task needs one. I will run the calls myself.
evals.expected_output: A Story title like [API-GATEWAY] Add per-client rate limiting (80 characters or fewer) and a body with the six ## sections. Acceptance criteria in Given/When/Then, mirrored into customfield_10234. Calls in order: getAccessibleAtlassianResources, a PROJ type lookup, searchJiraIssuesUsingJql for a duplicate, then createJiraIssue with contentFormat markdown and the Story type from the project's own list. It asks for the project to be confirmed before the create and does not claim the issue exists.
expectations: [code] Title matches `\[[A-Z][A-Z0-9-]+\] \S` and is at most 80 characters
[code] Body has the six sections as `##` headings (Intent, Constraints, Technical Interface, Logic, Validation, Resources; match by keyword)
[code] Body has Given, When and Then
[code] Calls list `getAccessibleAtlassianResources`, then `searchJiraIssuesUsingJql` before `createJiraIssue`
[code] Mirrors the ACs into `customfield_10234`
[code] Uses `contentFormat` markdown
[jev] Picks the Story type from the project's own type list
[jev] Asks Alex to confirm the project before the create
[jev] Does not claim it created the issue
